text: I have ynab notes about the YNAB rules. 30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Give Every Dollar a Job (YNAB Rule 1) is one of them. Find all related notes and refresh and enrich the pkm graph. Also, search for other related notes to link and update the typed edges

cmd: which shale; ls 30_Library/100_zettelkasten | grep -i -E "ynab|give every dollar|four rules|roll with the punches|age your money|true expense"; grep -rli "ynab" --include=*.md . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./.shale" | head -60

uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --audit 2>&1 | tail -40; uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --why "Give Every Dollar a Job (YNAB Rule 1)" 2>&1 | tail -30

find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f \( -iname "*ynab*" -o -iname "*true expense*" -o -iname "*roll with*" -o -iname "*age your money*" -o -iname "*spendfulness*" -o -iname "*zero-based*" \) -print; echo ---; ls 30_Library/100_zettelkasten | grep -i -E "budget|financ|money|spend|pound|dollar|income|saving|debt"; echo ---; sed -n 1,200p "30_Library/SoT/SoT - YNAB Current Goal Feature.md" | head -5; grep -n "typed\|implements\|::" 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py | head -5

git log --all --oneline --diff-filter=D --name-only -- "*YNAB*" "*Spendfulness*" "*True Expenses*" 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rli "true expense" /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/Hermes --include=*.md 2>/dev/null | head -5

title: Create YNAB Rules 2-4 atomic notes and add typed edges linking the four rules to existing finance notes
body: User chose: create Rules 2-4 from SoT - Family Financial Wellness content, resolve dangling links, wire typed edges. Not touching protected notes (own_words, journals, 20_Thinking).

cmd: shale intent "Create YNAB Rules 2-4 atomic notes and add typed edges linking the four rules to existing finance notes" --body "User chose: create Rules 2-4 from SoT - Family Financial Wellness content, resolve dangling links, wire typed edges. Not touching protected notes (own_words, journals, 20_Thinking)." ; cat "30_Library/SoT/SoT - Atomic Note Standard (The Proposition Card).md" | head -150; grep -l "own_words: true" 30_Library/100_zettelkasten/*.md 30_Library/SoT/*.md 30_Library/MoC/*.md 2>/dev/null | head

cd /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/30_Library && ls 100_zettelkasten | grep -i -E "^Habit 1|Understanding Debt|Resilience is|Reframe Habit|Financial Double"; head -20 "100_zettelkasten/Understanding Debt.md"; sed -n 1,25p "100_zettelkasten/High-Frequency Micro-Spending Drains Resources.md"; sed -n 1,20p "100_zettelkasten/Habit 1 - Be Proactive.md"; sed -n 1,25p "100_zettelkasten/Resilience is the Ability to Bounce Back from Setbacks.md"

ls /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/30_Library/100_zettelkasten | grep -i "Intentional Friction"; sed -n 1,40p "/Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/10_System/templates/Template - Atomic Zettel.md" 2>/dev/null || ls /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon/10_System/templates | head -30

cd /Volumes/DAL/Zettelkasten/LLMeon && V=30_Library/100_zettelkasten; uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --path 30_Library 2>&1 | grep -i -E "ynab|Rule [1-4]|Reactive Spending|Guilt-Free|Living Paycheck|error|dangling" | head -20; echo ---SHAPE; uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/validate_note_shape.py --path "$V/Embrace Your True Expenses (YNAB Rule 2).md" "$V/Roll With The Punches (YNAB Rule 3).md" "$V/Age Your Money (YNAB Rule 4).md" 2>&1 | tail -20; echo ---; tail -4 "$V/Guilt-Free Spending is a Feature of Intentional Budgeting.md"; tail -6 "$V/Reactive Spending Creates Financial Stress.md"; for r in 1 2 3 4; do uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --why "$(ls $V | grep "YNAB Rule $r" | sed 's/\.md$//')" 2>&1 | head -8; done

note: Created YNAB Rules 2-4 notes; added typed edges and links across Rule 1, finance claims, SoT and MoC; edge_lint clean for touched notes

cmd: tail -8 "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/Reactive Spending Creates Financial Stress.md"; uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py --path 30_Library 2>&1 | tail -3; shale done --note "Created YNAB Rules 2-4 notes; added typed edges and links across Rule 1, finance claims, SoT and MoC; edge_lint clean for touched notes" --model claude-sonnet-5-5
